name: El Roko

coord_source.ref: way 1196100517 (building, leisure=sports_centre, El Roko, Calle Ronda 2, same phone as the gym site)

research_notes: Own site: day entry 9 EUR, opening hours 10-22 daily, address C/Ronda 2 (bajo) on the legal pages and the Instagram bio. Own news post of 7 July 2021 (gym opened 2 July 2021): 754 m2 climbable on about 1,000 m2, "una gran zona con 95 bloques escalables de diferentes dificultades" plus a rope zone used for courses. The home page says rope use needs contact or a form ("Necesario contactar para uso de la cuerda"), i.e. bouldering is the default offer. Instagram (read through a fetch summary, the page is login-walled for direct reads): latest post 16 Sep 2026, 2026/2027 course enrolment, August 2026 hours (Mon-Fri 10-22, Sat 10-14 and 16-22, Sun closed) and a Kilter Board in the highlights. The website has had no news since Sept 2021, so open-now rests on the Instagram activity.
